answer_1.quote: Our research explores the application of this structure to academic abstracts, aiming to improve their logical flow and optimize reader comprehension.
answer_1.outputs: Restructured academic abstracts in ABT format

answer_2.quote: To quantitatively evaluate how well a text adheres to the ABT structure, we employ a novel metric known as Extrema-Bounded Dynamic Time Warping (EB-DTW).

answer_4.quote: The qualitative metrics include human evaluation results for the original and outputted abstracts with regard to: content, organization, language, and overall (coherence).
answer_4.guideline: We ask the evaluator to rate each abstract on a scale of 1-7 in terms of four categories: content, organization, and language, as defined in, as well as an overall readability score.
